evidence: The existing dual-track protocol explicitly keeps live remote authority outside candidate-controlled code and assigns git ls-remote plus HEAD-containment checks to the caller until a trusted wrapper or platform enforces them.

Before review and challenge, live git ls-remote origin refs/heads/dev returned bcdd82a682710a562cbd9cdba5e248d0dfa2e222 and git rev-list --count HEAD..<sha> returned 0 at 2026-09-02T03:52:21Z and 2026-09-02T03:53:10Z.

Adding a new candidate-owned verifier would expand this npm version PR into review-governance design and still could not authenticate its own remote observation; the required live recheck remains an external landing action.
